item.title: Bactong clinches Liga VP in Oro
item.description: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Barangay Balubal Chairman Pablo Bactong won the vice-presidential race of the Liga ng mga Barangay–Cagayan de Oro Chapter, securing 54 votes during the election held Friday morning, February 27. item.title: 1,000 marijuana hills uprooted in Bukidnon raid
item.description: ILIGAN CITY — Authorities uprooted around 1,000 fully grown marijuana plants during a joint anti-drug operation in a remote area of Sitio Catablaran, Barangay Canangaan, Cabanglasan, Bukidnon, at about 6:30 a.m. on February 28. item.title: Alagar: ‘Personal grudges’ behind Oro, Initao killings
item.description: CAGAYAN DE ORO — The top brass of PNP Region 10 confirmed yesterday that "personal motives" fueled the recent high-profile killings of a working student in Cagayan de Oro and a businesswoman in Initao. Brigadier Gen. Christopher Abrahano revealed that a suspect has been identified in the Bhea Yna Balus case, while a politician from outside the region is being tagged in the Initao shooting. The post Alagar: ‘Personal grudges’ behind Oro, Initao killings appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.

item.title: Jordanian linked to Sydney terror attack nabbed in Pagadian
item.description: PAGADIAN CITY — A joint security operation led to the arrest of a 65-year-old Jordanian national for immigration violations on Monday. While the arrest was for overstaying, authorities are conducting a deep-dive security review into the suspect’s business records, which reportedly appeared in investigations linked to the December 2025 terrorist attack in Sydney, Australia. The post Jordanian linked to Sydney terror attack nabbed in Pagadian appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.
